{{Quote|Jabba ain't gonna be happy—!|Spiker decided to give up their pursuit|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 3">[[Shadows of the Empire 3|''Shadows of the Empire'' 3]]</ref>}}
The '''Beggar's Canyon Incident''' take place on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when a [[Gizz's Gang|Jabba's swoop gang]] attacks Luke Skywalker at [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|Ben Kenobi's hut]].__TOC__

==Background==
{{Quote|Skywalker was spotted in Kenobi's old place.''"<br />"''Jabba will pay extra to one who blasts his bones.''"<br />"''Let's FRY him!|Jabba's swoopers' discussion of kill Luke|<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref>}}
Following the [[Battle of Gall]], Luke finds that Janson's droid had been programmed by a [[Viera Cheran|technician]] to kill him; the technician is shot by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge]] and discovered that she was paid by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] (actually by [[Guri]]). [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] decides to make contact to an underground organization in the hopes of finding out who is responsible. Unfortunately she decides to make contact with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], unaware that [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] is the one who wants Luke dead. Leia also asks Luke to go to Tatooine after [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] not knowing that Xizor expects so; she also secretly hires [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Rendar]] to follow and protect him.

[[Gizman|Big Gizz]], while on the town with his buds, is challenged by a mysterious stranger, [[Wrenga Jixton|Jix]], in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. When Jix steals [[Spiker]]'s swoop, Gizz is impressed with his willingness to cheat. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] just got a transmission that interfered with Jix's instructions to ensure Luke's survival: that Luke is there, and he is more useful dead. After a discussion in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] that Dash overhears, Jix and the gang race over to kill Luke.

==The pursuit==
{{Quote|Blast the little runt to Bespin, boys!|Big Gizz|<ref name="SOTEN" />}}
At Ben Kenobi's hut, Luke tests [[Luke_Skywalker's_lightsaber|the new]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] he has constructed according to the instructions from [[Obi-Wan's Journal]] he found inside. Once the swoop bikers arrive, Luke deflects several blaster bolts before he slashes aside one of the riders and steals a bike within the twists and turns of [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]] with Dash coming behind. During the frail, Luke is unknowingly aided by Jix who sabotages his fellows' attempts to hit Luke. When Spiker gets a clear shot at Luke, Jix rams his swoop into Spiker's to keep Luke alive. The pursuers are halved and Luke loses them by passing through the [[Stone Needle/Legends|Stone Needle]] when Rendar arrives, drops into the canyon and opens fire causing them to scatter and flee. Although Jix breaks a leg in the crash, Spiker is nearly dead. Gizz falls from his bike and levels his rifle at Luke; he's struck in the skull with a rock by Jix.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|It may be vital to the Alliance. Want to come along, Dash?''"<br />"''Why not? Gonna earn my pay.|Luke Skywalker and Dash Rendar, ready to leaving Tatooine|<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)" />}}
After fending off an attack by a swoop gang, Skywalker encountered a [[Courier droid/Legends|message droid]] that was originally sent to Organa, who had gone to meet with Black Sun representatives. However, Skywalker was able to determine the password to reveal the message. The message was sent by [[Koth Melan]], a [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan spymaster]], that claiming to have vital information for the Alliance and requesting a meeting as soon as possible on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. Skywalker traveled to meet with Melan along with Rendar.

==Behind the scenes==
The Chase appears in almost all media of the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project, with the ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|comic series]] fleshing out its background and the participants.<ref name="secrets">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>

Continuity editor [[Allan Kausch]] assembled a summary of the basic action of the Chase, so as to be followed consistently through the media. In that June 19 memo, common elements would be: Luke defending himself with his new lightsaber, stealing a swoop, escape to the Canyon, the [[Dead Man's Turn/Legends|Dead Man's Turn]] and the [[Stone Needle/Legends|Eye of the Needle]].<ref name="secrets" />

The Chase in the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|video game]] diverges from the other media, showing Dash Rendar exterminating all of [[Gizz's Gang]] within [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. There is no courier droid, and it is Luke who briefs Rendar on the [[Raid on the Suprosa|''Suprosa'' mission]]. Luke also wears his black uniform seen in {{Film|6}} instead of the casual [[jacket/Legends|jacket]]ed attire he wears in other media during the ''Shadows'' storyline.<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire video game">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref> The 3d environment of the Mos Eisley scenery, as well as the "conehead" swoop bikers, largely derive from concept art made by [[Industrial Light & Magic|Industrial Light and Magic]] for the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|special edition]] of {{Film|4}}.<ref name="secrets" />
